[RDSC.11.4] **A body is decoded before it is judged.** A loader **must**
refuse with `DS_ERR_DSC_DECODE` an atom body that fails protobuf decode, or that
holds a field more than once as [RDSC.9.5] refuses, whatever other defect the
body carries. A loader **must not** judge a body by any other rule
until the body has decoded; a body that decodes and breaks another rule is
refused with the code that rule names.

A loader **must not** read the bytes inside an `Expr` nested deeper than
[RDSC.11.3]'s limit of 48. It reads that `Expr`'s field in its parent, a tag and
a length within the bytes that remain, and no more. A body whose bytes decode
down to that limit and that holds an `Expr` nested deeper is
`DS_ERR_DSC_SEMANTIC` ([RDSC.11.3]), whatever the bytes inside that `Expr` hold.
So no loader recurses past the limit to answer for a body, however deep its
bytes nest ([RDSC.9.9]).
